usr_demo_101.name: Alex Morgan
usr_demo_101.resumeText: Senior engineer with 5 years experience in React and Node.js with distributed caching and PostgreSQL

shortlistResult.summary: The candidate presents direct alignment with the core Full Stack ecosystem through React, Node.js, distributed caching, and PostgreSQL. With 5 years of experience, they sit right at the entry threshold for a senior designation, though the brief resume lacks evidence of technical leadership and cloud-scale architecture.
shortlistResult.seniorityAssessment: 5 years of experience borders between strong mid-level and entry senior; technical leadership and architectural ownership need validation.
keyStrengths: Cohesive and modern core technology stack (React + Node.js + PostgreSQL)
Familiarity with distributed caching layers for performance optimization
Balanced coverage of both client-side and server-side engineering
areasToScrutinizeInInterview: Cache invalidation, concurrency, and distributed consistency strategies
Database schema design, query optimization, and indexing at scale in PostgreSQL
Experience with DevOps, deployment pipelines, and architectural leadership
shortlistResult.interviewAdvice: Be prepared to deep-dive into distributed system trade-offs, caching challenges, and concrete architectural decisions you led rather than just feature implementation.
